Program · Good, Great & Amazing

Lawn Care Programs

All-inclusive ongoing lawn care in three levels: mowing, edging, fertilising, weed and grub control and soil amendments.

Lawn Mowing & Overgrown Lawn Cuts

Overgrown lawns cut back under control, then kept that way with regular mowing and edging.

Garden Tidy-Ups & General Gardening

One-off or general gardening: weeding, pruning and hedge trimming for a full garden tidy-up.

Program · Good, Great & Amazing

Garden Maintenance Programs

Scheduled, all-inclusive garden care: pest and disease control, fertilising, weed control and all pruning, hedging and trimming.

Mulching & Small Landscaping

Garden bed mulching to save water and keep things tidy, plus small projects like planting and laying paths.

Lawn Renovation & Aeration

Mix & match lawn and garden

Lawn and garden programs are chosen separately, so you only pay for the level you want in each part of the yard. One of our most common combinations is a Great Lawn Program with a Good Garden Program: a standout lawn, with tidy, healthy garden beds around it.
